cmd.description: Mount the SAS Viya CLI token cache into the container. The server reads ~/.sas/credentials.json, and $HOME is /app inside the image, so the .sas directory has to land at /app/.sas.

environmentVariables.description: Expose only tools that neither change server-side state nor cause server-side work (43 of 75). Composes with MCP_TIERS.
